description:
Phase 4.7 — Spring Boot starter plugins depend on. Provides:
          * @PluginCapability and @PluginEndpoint annotations,
          * RegistrationLifecycleBean (handshake on ApplicationReadyEvent),
          * HeartbeatPublisher (@Scheduled),
          * Auto-configuration that builds the registration payload from application.yml,
          * Default exception handler that maps thrown exceptions to PluginErrorResponse.
        Plugin authors include this module + write capability beans; the SDK does the rest.
